rules.content:
SELECT
    zd.nameserver_pair,
    zd.registrar_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT zd.domain_name) AS domains_registered,
    MIN(zd.registration_date) AS first_registration,
    MAX(zd.registration_date) AS last_registration,
    DATEDIFF(hour, MIN(zd.registration_date), MAX(zd.registration_date)) AS registration_window_hours,
    AVG(LENGTH(zd.sld)) AS avg_sld_length,
    STDDEV(LENGTH(zd.sld)) AS sld_length_stddev,
    COUNT(DISTINCT zd.tld) AS tld_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT zd.resolved_ip) AS unique_ips
FROM zone_file_diffs zd
WHERE zd.diff_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day'
  AND zd.event_type = 'new_registration'
GROUP BY zd.nameserver_pair, zd.registrar_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT zd.domain_name) >= 50
   AND DATEDIFF(hour, MIN(zd.registration_date), MAX(zd.registration_date)) <= 24
ORDER BY domains_registered DESC;
rules.title: SQL — Zone File Diff RDGA Registration Burst Detection (Phase 2)

rules.content:
SELECT
    ns.nameserver_pair,
    ns.nameserver_ip,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.domain_name) AS domain_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.registrar_id) AS registrar_count,
    AVG(DATEDIFF(day, d.registration_date, CURRENT_DATE)) AS avg_domain_age_days,
    MIN(d.registration_date) AS earliest_registration,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.resolved_ip) AS unique_resolved_ips,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.tld) AS tld_diversity
FROM dns_records ns
JOIN domains d ON ns.domain_name = d.domain_name
WHERE ns.record_type = 'NS'
  AND d.registration_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days'
GROUP BY ns.nameserver_pair, ns.nameserver_ip
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.domain_name) >= 100
   AND AVG(DATEDIFF(day, d.registration_date, CURRENT_DATE)) < 30
ORDER BY domain_count DESC;
rules.title: SQL — Nameserver Concentration Anomaly Detection (Phase 2-3)

rules.content:
index=dns sourcetype=dns_query
| lookup rdga_cluster_feed domain AS query_domain OUTPUT cluster_id, cluster_confidence, actor_attribution, campaign_type
| where isnotnull(cluster_id) AND cluster_confidence >= 75
| stats count AS query_count,
        dc(src_ip) AS unique_endpoints,
        dc(query_domain) AS unique_rdga_domains,
        values(actor_attribution) AS attributed_actors,
        values(campaign_type) AS campaign_types,
        earliest(_time) AS first_query,
        latest(_time) AS last_query
    BY cluster_id
| where query_count >= 5 OR unique_endpoints >= 3
| eval duration_hours = round((last_query - first_query) / 3600, 1)
| table cluster_id, attributed_actors, campaign_types, unique_rdga_domains, unique_endpoints, query_count, duration_hours
| sort - unique_endpoints
rules.title: Splunk — RDGA Domain Resolution Detection in Enterprise DNS (Phase 4)

rules.content:
title: DNS Resolution of Domains Served by Known RDGA Nameserver Clusters
status: experimental
description: >
  Detects DNS queries resolving domains that are served by authoritative
  nameservers identified as part of RDGA campaigns through zone file analysis
  and nameserver clustering. RDGA campaigns are characterized by hundreds to
  thousands of domains sharing a small number of nameservers, with correlated
  registration timing and lexical patterns.
logsource:
    product: dns
    service: query_log
detection:
    selection:
        query_type:
            - 'A'
            - 'AAAA'
            - 'CNAME'
    filter_rdga_ns:
        authoritative_ns|contains:
            - 'ns1.rdga-indicator-1.example'
            - 'ns2.rdga-indicator-1.example'
    condition: selection and filter_rdga_ns
level: high
tags:
    - cfpf.phase4.execution
    - attack.t1568.002
    - attack.t1583.001
    - flame.rdga
    - flame.dns_intelligence
rules.title: Sigma — RDGA Nameserver Cluster DNS Resolution (Phase 3-4)

rules.content:
title: Bulk Let's Encrypt Certificate Issuance for Correlated Domains
status: experimental
description: >
  Detects bulk TLS certificate issuance events from Let's Encrypt (or other
  free CAs) for domains that share registration timing, nameserver
  infrastructure, or lexical patterns consistent with RDGA campaigns.
  Certificate Transparency log monitoring enables detection of RDGA domain
  activation before malicious content is deployed.
logsource:
    product: certificate_transparency
    service: ct_log
detection:
    selection:
        issuer_cn|contains: "Let's Encrypt"
        certificate_type: 'DV'
    aggregation:
        count|gte: 50
        groupby: issuer_account_fingerprint
        timeframe: 24h
    condition: selection and aggregation
level: medium
tags:
    - cfpf.phase2.initial_access
    - attack.t1583.001
    - flame.rdga
    - flame.certificate_intelligence
rules.title: Sigma — Bulk Let's Encrypt Certificate Issuance Correlation (Phase 2)
